metadata.description: Agent Runbooks: procedures an agent session runs through subagents

plugins.name: agent-runbook-authoring
plugins.description: Writes runbooks: procedures an agent session runs through subagents. The steps are prompt files, the transitions are a few lines of Python on a small engine, and the orchestrator never reasons about what comes next.

plugins.name: runbook-viewer
plugins.description: Shows the progress of a runbook run: a text status the orchestrator prints after every step, and a read-only page on localhost with each step's log and output files.
